9 MS. SPINELLI: Mr. Chief Justice, and may it
10 please the Court:
11 Respondents' position is that Section 506(d)
12 of the Bankruptcy Code allows Chapter 7 debtors to keep
13 their houses, strip their underwater mortgages, and
14 prevent their lenders from accessing any later
15 appreciation in a house's value. In Dewsnup, this Court
16 rejected that position with respect to partially
17 underwater mortgages and that reasoning applies with
18 equal force to completely underwater mortgages.
19 Dewsnup held that Section 506(d) voids only
20 liens securing disallowed claims. It does not void
21 liens based on the current value of the collateral.
22 That logic applies whether the current value of the
23 collateral is a million dollars, $1 or zero, as
24 virtually every court to address the question has held,
25 and even the Eleventh Circuit below all but admitted.

25 water every day.
